author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_c7_corpus_goldens_missing.rs::divergence_c7_corpus_and_cert_goldens_exist demonstrates the divergence: run with --ignored, it FAILS listing all 6 missing design-mandated artifacts (conformance/option_result.th + .cert.json, conformance/parse_u64.th + .cert.json, tests/golden/lower/{option_result,parse_u64}.verus.rs). Authority: .design/basis/09-option-result.md 'Acceptance criteria' + 'Routes to add' (the routes carry reference=[] in tooling/spec-routes.toml). C7 is verified only against ephemeral temp .th programs in option_result_conformance.rs, NOT the external cert/golden oracle goal.md verification model (B) + R-CHAR-3 mandate. The toolchain BEHAVIOR is correct (payload projection genuine, parse_u64 round-trip proven non-vacuously, no unsound shadow) — the gap is the missing external oracle artifact, an orchestrator-authoring deliverable.
